resolved.title: 队列
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Queue[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

A [b]queue [/b]is similar to a stack, but defines a different way to add and remover elements. 
The elements are inserted from one end, called the [b]rear[/b], and deleted from the other end, called the [b]front[/b].
This behavior is called [b]FIFO [/b](First in First Out). [img id="3193" width="100%"]
[s0l0!-header][b]Terminology[/b][/s0l0!-header]
The process of adding new elements into the queue is called [b]enqueue[/b].
The process of removal of an element from the queue is called [b]dequeue[/b].

[s0l0!-header][b]Applications[/b][/s0l0!-header]
Queues are used whenever we need to manage objects in order starting with the first one in.
Scenarios include printing documents on a printer, call center systems answering people on hold, and so on.
[note]Python [b]lists[/b] are the easiest way to implement a queue functionality.[/note]

content.text:
一个**队列**(Queue)类似于一个栈(Stack)，但定义了一种不同的添加和删除元素的方式。
元素从一端插入，称为**后端**，从另一端删除，称为**前端**。
这种行为被称为**FIFO **（先入先出）。
content.text_html:
A **queue **is similar to a stack, but defines a different way to add and remover elements. The elements are inserted from one end, called the rear, and deleted from the other end, called the front. This behavior is called **FIFO **(First in First Out).

一个队列类似于一个堆栈，但定义了一种不同的添加和删除元素的方式。 元素从一端插入，称为后端，从另一端删除，称为前端。 这种行为被称为**FIFO **（先入先出）。

content.text:
**术语**：
- 向队列中添加新元素的过程被称为**enqueue**（入队）。
- 从队列中移除一个元素的过程称为**dequeue**（出队）。

**应用**：
当我们需要从第一个对象开始按顺序管理对象时，就会用到队列。
场景包括在打印机上打印文件，呼叫中心系统回答等待的人，排队结账等等。
content.text_html:
Terminology The process of adding new elements into the queue is called enqueue. The process of removal of an element from the queue is called dequeue.

Applications Queues are used whenever we need to manage objects in order starting with the first one in. Scenarios include printing documents on a printer, call center systems answering people on hold, and so on.

resolved.title: 呼叫排队处理
resolved.problem_statement_md:
你正在编写一个呼叫中心应用程序，它在一个队列中排队处理客户。

**CallCenter**类被实现为一个队列**Queue** 。队列中的每个元素表示呼叫的类型。两个可能的值是"general"和 "technical" 。：

- 普通"general"电话平均需要5分钟来处理，
- 技术"technical"电话需要10分钟。

给出的代码根据用户的输入将多个呼叫类型添加到队列中。
你需要对所有添加的客户呼叫进行排队处理，计算并输出处理所有电话所需的总时间。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Queue[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are making a call center application, which should handle customers in a queue.
The [b]CallCenter[/b] class is implemented as a [b]Queue[/b]. Each element of the queue has the topic of the call as its value. The two possible values are '[b]general'[/b] and '[b]technical'[/b].  A 'general' call takes on average [b]5[/b] minutes to handle, while a 'technical' call requires [b]10[/b] minutes.
The given code adds multiple customers to the Queue from user input. 
You need to dequeue all added customers, calculate and output the total time required to handle all calls. 
[note]Use a while loop to dequeue all the customers from the queue, until it is empty.[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 使用while循环从队列中提取所有的客户呼叫，直到它为空。
